effect.name: Simulation Color Blindness AIO (Switch)
effect.description: The shader contains all color blindness effects in one.
effect.author: Foxioo (Special thanks to: MaPePeR)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Simulation Color Blindness AIO (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.23 */
parameter.description: The shader contains all color blindness effects in one. (Special thanks to: MaPePeR)

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines what the base should be. Setting it to 0 sets the base as the texture of the object on which the effect is applied, and setting it to 1 sets this as the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Mode
parameter.description: This variable specifies which mode should be used. 0: Achromatomal; 1: Achromatopsia; 2: Deuteranomaly; 3: Deuteranopia; 4: Protanomaly; 5: Protanopia; 6: Tritanomaly; 7: Tritanopia;
